name: Calico Wilder and the Crystal Blade
description:
About This Game

Calico Wilder and the Crystal Blade is a 3D platforming adventure starring Calico Wilder, a bright-eyed feline Relic Hunter with an insatiable curiosity. He is accompanied by his girlfriend and partner-in-purr-ime Lilly Regnalia, as he jumps head-first into an ancient temple in search of the Crystal Blade, a strange and powerful Relic. Join the duo in their first adventure, inspired by platforming classics of the early 2000's!

  • A short but exciting adventure through a mysterious temple full of secrets and surprises!

  • Traverse a variety of levels (and perhaps a couple secret ones) with platforming challenges, shiny collectibles, and monstrous foes aplenty!

  • 2 playable characters! Use the Crystal Blade's power as Calico to spin, pole-vault, and warp-strike your way through obstacles, and wield Lilly's trusty rapier to slash-and-dash through whatever comes your way!

  • A classic art style! Feast your eyes on a blend of 3D visuals inspired by games of the early 2000's, and vibrant hand-drawn scenes and character portraits!

  • Fully voiced dialogue! Enjoy charming dialogue exchanges, fully voiced by a top-notch cast!
short_desc: Calico Wilder and the Crystal Blade is a 3D platformer inspired by classics of the early 2000's. Join Relic Hunters Calico and Lilly as they traverse an ancient temple in search of a strange and powerful artifact: the Crystal Blade!
